accounting.rationale: Defines initial-team establishment for nonallocatable coarrays with SAVE. SAVE and coarray declaration eligibility remain with 8.5.16 and 8.5.6; runtime image/team facets are out of scope.
Defines allocated allocatable coarray establishment and unallocated non-establishment. Allocation status transitions remain with 9.7.1.3 and 9.7.3.2.
Defines establishment in a CHANGE TEAM construct for coarrays established in the executing team. CHANGE TEAM execution and team semantics remain with 11.1.5.
Defines establishment for CHANGE TEAM coarray-association associating entities. The association syntax and team behavior remain with 11.1.5 and 19.5.1.
Defines establishment team for nonallocatable coarray associating entities in ASSOCIATE, SELECT RANK and SELECT TYPE. Construct association owners remain in Clause 11 and Clause 19.

Defines invocation-team establishment for nonallocatable coarray dummy arguments and host association with them, and excludes ancestor-team establishment. Procedure invocation and association details remain with Clause 15 and 19.5.1.
